evaluation_prompts: Inside a brightly lit gymnastics arena, a female gymnast accelerates diagonally across the spring floor, drives through a front handspring, and rebounds into a compact double back tuck. She opens cleanly, touches down, and immediately rises into a full-twisting layout, drawing her arms close as her straight body rotates before extending for the landing. The camera tracks her from the side at floor level, keeping her centered while the blue mat and blurred spectators sweep behind her. Chalk dust lifts from each contact, her ponytail follows the rotation, and she finishes upright with both arms raised.

A gymnast sprints along the vault runway with quick, powerful strides, punches the springboard, and reaches firmly for the vaulting table. The block through her shoulders sends her high into a triple-twisting Yurchenko, her body held straight while her arms draw inward to accelerate the rotation. A side-on tracking shot follows the complete approach, flight, and landing beneath clean arena lighting. The table drops away behind her, the competition mat fills the frame below, and she opens from the twist in time to absorb the landing with bent knees and one small controlled step backward.

On a polished ice rink beneath bright arena spotlights, a figure skater glides backward on a deep outside edge, gathering speed with two strong crossovers. The skater plants the takeoff blade and springs into a triple axel, arms and free leg snapping close to the torso through three and a half fast revolutions. The camera follows from a medium side angle, moving smoothly parallel to the jump. Fine ice crystals scatter from the takeoff mark, then spray again as one blade meets the ice. The skater opens the arms, extends the free leg, and rides away on a long, stable landing edge.

At the edge of a ten-meter platform, a diver makes a measured approach and drives upward from the board into open blue sky. The diver folds into a tight tuck for three fast forward somersaults while adding one controlled body twist, then opens progressively into a long vertical line. A telephoto side view holds the full trajectory against the sky and blue pool below, making each change from tuck to extension easy to read. The diver aligns hands, head, hips, and pointed feet before entering the water almost vertically, leaving a narrow white plume and only a small ring of ripples on the surface.
